newsitem.title: USA: Magness estate selling 32 mln TCI shares.
newsitem.headline: Magness estate selling 32 mln TCI shares.

text.p: Affiliates of Merrill Lynch & Co and Lehman Brothers have agreed to buy 32 million shares of Tele-Communications Inc Series A TCI Group stock from the estate of TCI founder Bob Magness for $16.52 per share, or about $528.6 million, TCI said Tuesday.
TCI Chief Executive John Malone said, "The estate has received the liquidity it needs and it has done so without the disruption that a sale of this magnitude might create in the public market..."
Also, he said, TCI has "controlled a very valuable block of voting stock."
He added, "Additionally, we have retained the ability to repurchase the TCOMA shares over this two-year period as we continue our commitment to work to improve our balance sheet and leverage ratios."

Prior to the sale to Merrill and Lehman, the estate will exchange about 30.5 million shares of Series B TCI Group common stock with TCI for an equal number of newly-issued Series A shares. The estate will then sell the new Series A shares and an additional 1.5 million Series A shares to the Merrill and Lehman affiliates.
TCI said it will hold the Series B shares in treasury.
